From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Linda Park <linda.park@medsys.com>

Subject: Deep-dive runbook + scheduling for MedSys VPC/IAM review

Hi Linda —

Thanks again for the time on Friday. We want to schedule a 90-minute technical deep-dive so our SEs can walk your eng/security teams through the VPC/on‑prem connectivity, network requirements, and IAM mapping. Goal is to validate design constraints and capture any procurement or audit blockers before we schedule an install window.

Attendees we recommend:
- MedSys: cloud eng + security + procurement rep
- Redwood: AE (me), SE (Marissa), Infra Eng (Priyom), Security lead (Neha)

Proposed slots (PST):
- Thurs 10/15 10:30–12:00
- Fri 10/16 08:00–09:30
- Mon 10/19 13:00–14:30

If none of these work, send a few best-available times and we’ll do our best to adapt. Also: if you can share a rough network diagram and any vendor-onboarding checklist items ahead of time, Marissa and Priyom will review and prep a short runbook.

Attachments: sample-runbook-template.md (attached to internal copy)

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
From: Linda Park <linda.park@medsys.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Deep-dive runbook + scheduling for MedSys VPC/IAM review

Ben —

Thanks. Quick notes from calendar side: 10/15 is tight for our cloud team (end-of-quarter) and procurement needs two weeks to review vendor terms. Possible windows: 10/19 after 12:30 or 10/21 in the morning (PST).

Also, security will require a SOC2 summary and our security intake form completed before any on‑prem/network diagrams are shared. I looped procurement and Alex (cloud infra) to coordinate.

Can your team confirm which materials you will need pre-meeting vs. what can be addressed in the session?

—Linda

linda.park@medsys.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 13:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Deep-dive runbook + scheduling for MedSys VPC/IAM review

Linda —

Totally understand the constraints. We can split the runbook materials into two buckets:

Pre-read (please share if allowed):
- High-level network diagram (subnets/VPN endpoints/NATs)
- Identity provider type (Okta/Azure AD) and basic role map
- Procurement onboarding checklist (if you have one)

To be covered in the session:
- Detailed port/route/troubleshooting expectations
- Example IAM mappings and least-privilege patterns for Redwood connectors
- Failover and fallback routing for cross-region traffic

We can send a redacted SOC2 summary and our standard connectivity runbook ahead of time. If procurement must run vendor onboarding first, we can mark the session as a non‑access-producing design review; that should be enough for your security team to validate architecture without data exchange.

Proposed final slots (PST):
- Wed 10/21 09:00–10:30
- Wed 10/21 11:00–12:30
- Mon 10/19 13:00–14:30 (still possible)

Let me know which of these works and I’ll send a calendar invite with an agenda and required pre-reads.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: procurement@medsys.com <procurement@medsys.com>

Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Deep-dive runbook + scheduling for MedSys VPC/IAM review

Ben / Linda —

Procurement here. To proceed with any technical deep-dive that edges toward onboarding, we need the following items submitted to our vendor portal at least five business days prior to the workshop:
1) W9 or equivalent tax docs
2) Draft MSA and standard SOW (we will send redlines)
3) Proof of SOC2 or equivalent (summary acceptable)
4) Contact for invoicing and legal

If Redwood prefers to do an architecture-only session (no customer data or credentials), we can waive some items temporarily — but legal will still need the draft MSA on file. Please advise how you want to proceed and when you can upload the listed documents.

Thanks,
MedSys Procurement
